port.name: Pi
port.description: Living Code for Pi: schema-complete custom themes for messages, tools, thinking levels, syntax, Markdown and HTML exports.

guide.installation:
Install as a theme-only Pi package:

```sh
pi install git:github.com/living-code-theme/pi
```

Run `/reload` and choose `living-code-night` under `/settings` → **Theme**. Alternatively, copy `themes/*.json` into `~/.pi/agent/themes/` (or your custom `PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR` followed by `/themes/`).
guide.configuration: Themes include every required color and the optional search, scrollbar and maximum-thinking colors. Export page/panel backgrounds are explicit. In `~/.pi/agent/settings.json`, `"theme": "living-code-paper/living-code-night"` follows the terminal appearance, with the light theme first. Package resources declare only themes: no tools, extensions or prompts are installed.
guide.compatibility: Verified against the Pi 1.1.0 theme schema and native JSON validator. Requires a Pi release supporting these theme roles. User themes hot-reload when the theme name matches the JSON filename; package themes can be refreshed with `/reload`. Project-scoped resources require project trust. Truecolor is recommended. No provider login or model call is needed to use or validate the theme.
